the factors that influence customers' loyalty in hospitals in China and the strategies that can be used by hospital managers to increase customer loyalty in the hospitals.
the factors affecting the loyalty of the patients of a hospital in the competitive healthcare industry of China.

the behavior of the staffs and doctors in a hospital has a direct and significant effect on patients' satisfaction, loyalty and referral of new patients to the same hospital.

, the behavior of hospital doctors and staffs towards patients is the most important factor in creating a 'Brand' for a hospital in China.

the attitude of doctors and nurses in hospitals is the most critical factor in determining patients' satisfaction and their loyalty towards hospitals.
